caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical tin container with a flat circular lid positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The container is primarily red in color and is decorated with painted patterns that include four large beige or light tan circular shapes evenly spaced around its sides. Surrounding these circles are symmetrical, swirling leaf-like designs in yellow, green, and brown. The top of the lid continues the decorative motif, featuring yellow-green circles. The composition is simple, with the tin canister being the only object, centered, and no other elements present in the background. The artist’s signature, “Mildred Ford,” appears in small letters in the bottom left corner.
title: Toleware Tea Caddy
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
